name: checkers
description: Checkers with a computer opponent, forced captures, drag and drop, hints and undo. Native SwirlOS app.
author: Leonid
title: Checkers
tagline: Play checkers against the computer or a friend.
long:
English checkers for SwirlOS: forced captures, multi-jumps, kings, drag-and-drop or click-to-move, legal move markers, move list, captured pieces, undo, hints and a flippable board.
Play as White or Black against the computer on four levels (Beginner to Strong), or two players on one screen.
Mouse or keyboard: arrow keys move the cursor, Enter/Space selects and moves.
Shortcuts: N new game, U undo, F flip, H hint, L level, Esc cancel.
